ns0:svg.ns0:title: H- pins / 1 — historical extruder without motor
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Historical source reference, not an energizable installation. No motor connection. Power, mating, firmware and load ratings unresolved.

ns0:svg.ns0:title: EAGLE XT30PW-F horizontal female power connector
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Separate EAGLE-package rendering of the horizontal female XT30PW-F family, with two 5 mm-spaced power contacts and distinct mounting-leg positions. Flat top-down Bouni-style vector artwork. Board pads and copper remain native.

ns0:svg.ns0:title: Top Connector Header (Molex KK 254, 1x03, 2.54 mm) - flat style
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: One of the six identical Molex KK 254 AE-6410-03A 3-way friction-lock headers (J24-J29) along the top edge of the Smoothieboard v2 Prime, drawn flat and top-down in the style of Bouni's Smoothieboard v1 diagrams.

ns0:svg.ns0:title: Fan connector (FAN_A+ / FAN_B+), Molex KK-254 2-circuit header
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Flat top-down illustration of a white 2-position Molex KK-254 friction-lock header with two square pins on a 2.54 mm pitch, Bouni style.

ns0:svg.ns0:title: Unshrouded 2x4 pin header, 2.54 mm pitch
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Two-row unshrouded male header with eight square posts on a 2.54 mm grid. Flat top-down Bouni-style vector artwork. Board pads and copper remain native.
